name: Weekend Scenic Riders
description: Easy-paced Saturday and Sunday morning rides to lakes, hills and breakfast spots. Nobody gets left behind.

messages.text: Anyone up for an easy loop this weekend? Thinking 80–100 km, back by lunch.
I'm in. Prefer starting early before it gets hot.
Count me in too. Let's keep it relaxed with a coffee stop halfway.

name: Beginner-Friendly Rides
description: For riders in their first couple of years. Short distances, frequent stops and patient riders who are happy to share tips.

messages.text: Still nervous on highways. Any tips for my first longer ride?
Ride with someone who's happy to go slow, keep 3-second gaps and plan a stop every 45 minutes.
Same here! Would love a practice ride on quiet roads.

name: Adventure & Touring
description: Long weekends, multi-day tours and the occasional dirt trail. Share routes, luggage setups and trip reports.

messages.text: Planning a three-day Western Ghats loop next month. Who's done the forest roads recently?
Did it in the summer. Carry a puncture kit and start early, fuel stops are far apart.

name: Sportbike Riders
description: Riders who enjoy twisty roads, track days and getting their lines right, with an emphasis on riding gear and riding within your limits.

messages.text: Track school signups open next week for anyone who wants to work on body position.
Interested! Is it okay for intermediate riders?

name: Cruiser Community
description: Classic and cruiser bikes, long relaxed rides and plenty of photo stops. All makes welcome.

messages.text: Sunset ride this week, anyone? Short one, mostly for photos.

name: East Bengaluru Riders
description: City-based group for riders around Whitefield, Marathahalli, Indiranagar and HSR. Weekday early rides before work traffic.

messages.text: Pre-work ride tomorrow if the weather holds. Out at 6, back by 8.

name: South Bengaluru Riders
description: City-based group for Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Basavanagudi, Koramangala and Electronic City riders.

messages.text: Evening ride + dinner on Friday? Keeping it chill.
If it's after 7 I can make it.
